<b>Pale Nails</b> is a [[Skills|Skill]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it summons three [[Silk]] talons that home on nearby [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]]. 

== Function ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] summons 3 spectral Nails that float behind her for a few seconds, before firing in straight lines, disappearing when they hit an enemy or a surface. If an enemy comes within range before the Nails fire, or was the closest enemy in range when cast, the Nails will target that enemy after a short delay and fire towards it, curving slightly as they travel towards the target. If the enemy dies before all Nails are expended, the Nails will continue in a straight line. If Pale Nails is cast again before the first set fire, they will fire in straight lines as if they had no target. Each Nail deals [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Needle|1x Needle Damage]] on hit, resulting in a total of 3x Needle Damage if all Nails hit the same enemy.

=== Modifiers ===
* [[Volt Filament]] electrifies Pale Nails, increasing the damage by 25% and adding a tick of 5 damage once per enemy.
* [[Shaman Crest]] sheathes Pale Nails in Soul, increasing the damage by 40%.
** Volt Filament and Shaman Crest's damage increases add together to grant +65% damage.
* [[Egg of Flealia]] reduces the cost of Pale Nails to 3 Silk while at full health.

== How to Acquire ==
Pale Nails can be obtained by binding [[Grand Mother Silk|Grand Mother Silk's]] severed arm after returning to [[the Cradle]] in [[Act 3]] by using [[Silk Soar]].
